rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with one dominant low, folded/barrel-like figure and a carved central void that reads across views. The open court/undercut provides a legible public threshold and responds reasonably to the access edge instead of sealing it off. It is not perfect as a gymnasium because the visible section is somewhat thin and the hall reads as compact rather than clearly long-span, but the gym semantic contract is still plausible at this stage. The silhouette is more continuous than stair-step, with the roof deformation functioning as a section gesture rather than arbitrary terracing. Overall the mass is acceptable and program-fit passes, though it could better articulate a stronger span/roof logic and a cleaner primary hall anchor.
